warningNote:
Did you think I wouldn't know you've been following me? Yes, you: the one reading this note. Maybe you thought I was a fool, or maybe you're the fool yourself. Either way, like me, you've surely now discovered the truth.

The Ascended of Arceuus were not the first to discover soul transference, after all. That honour belongs to the Old Ones. Had they not destroyed themselves, they might still be walking among us today.

Make no mistake, I will find the remaining knowledge left by the Old Ones. I will discover the secrets of soul transference. As for you, I will only consider you one of two things. Either you're my ally, or my enemy. Only time will tell.

Until we cross paths again,
Kasonde Shaw

dirtyNotes:
This language is fascinating. I've already managed to translate a few words, but it's going to take a lot more to discover anything of use.

From what I've found so far, it seems that most words are quite generic and often have multiple connected meanings depending on the context. For example, change things slightly and a word for 'sea' might suddenly mean 'river' instead. Change things even more, and it could become 'cold'. I'll need to bear this in mind as I continue my work.

Vines! Vines everywhere! I'm on the verge of greatness here, but something always gets in the way.

On that note, a few vines may not be all I have to contend with. Upon returning to camp to pick up some secateurs, I found my journal had gone missing. It seems I'm not alone in my search. I'll need to be cautious.
There's something different about this place. Something familiar. A stench of death that's hard to forget. Could this be where the Strangler was born?
